changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: MrScruff's CTRL IN PERF, ported to OS 1.74 by Iced-Cream.
PERF DEST in GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 and 2 sends a CV or EXPR jack to PF1 to PF12.
The jack sets the macro as its knob would, its locks follow, and it always wins over the knob and pad.
PERF DEST is saved with the globals slot.
Documentation-only: a CV source at 0, 2.5 and 5 V drove PF1 and its lock on a unit. Code unchanged.
